description.blurb: 4183 Cuno is an eccentric, rare-type asteroid, classified as near-Earth object, roughly 4 kilometers in diameter.
description.more: The asteroid has an Earth minimum orbital intersection distance of 0.0283 AU (4,230,000 km), which translates into 11 lunar distances. Cuno approaches the Earth to within 40 million kilometers six times in the 21st century. On May 20th, 2012, it made its closest Earth approach at a distance of 0.122 AU (18,000,000 km). It will not make a closer approach until 2093 when it will pass Earth at 0.084 AU (13,000,000 km).
